prompts: Review my week, it is Friday afternoon.
I feel like things slipped through this week. Can we go through what is overdue and who I am waiting on?
Weekly review, but this week was quiet: no overdue tasks, no waiting tasks, and no AI notes with ai: pending.

assertions.check: The agent opens this week's weekly note in Calendar/Weekly Notes/ (or creates it from the weekly template if missing) before listing task loops.
The agent lists overdue tasks, waiting tasks and the Stale 14 days view, and changes no task's status or date_due until the human answers per task.
The agent shows at most five ai: pending notes, oldest first, and sets ai: approved only on notes the human explicitly approved.
The agent proposes Atlas lessons and stale-claim fixes and creates or edits none of them until the human approves.
Each System friction item is added as one line in the form 'YYYY-MM-DD | neg | weekly friction | text' to the memory Inbox.
When a step has nothing to show, the agent skips it with a one-line statement instead of inventing findings.
The agent adds one log entry in the form '## [YYYY-MM-DD] weekly-review | YYYY-Www' with bullets for notes approved, notes created, friction lines captured and claims flagged.
